cases.name: internal-lang BCP 47 language codes are served
cases.gherkin:
Scenario: internal-lang BCP 47 language codes are served
  When Client validates a code against the code system on TxServer with:
    """
    { "resourceType": "Parameters", "parameter": [
        { "name": "url", "valueUri": "urn:ietf:bcp:47" },
        { "name": "code", "valueCode": "pt-PT" } ] }
    """
  Then $response.status should be 200
  And $response should satisfy "parameter.where(name = 'result').value = true"

cases.name: dicom-cs-lookup The DICOM code system from fhir.dicom is served
cases.gherkin:
# The package version is named: the server also holds a DCM code system of
# version 01, which it uses when no version is given, and ANN is not in it.
# This test needs updating when a new fhir.dicom version is loaded (#14).
@package:fhir.dicom
Scenario: dicom-cs-lookup The DICOM code system from fhir.dicom is served
  When Client looks up a code on TxServer with:
    """
    { "resourceType": "Parameters", "parameter": [
        { "name": "system", "valueUri": "http://dicom.nema.org/resources/ontology/DCM" },
        { "name": "version", "valueString": "2025.3.20250714" },
        { "name": "code", "valueCode": "ANN" } ] }
    """
  Then $response.status should be 200
  And $response should satisfy "parameter.where(name = 'display').value = 'Annotation'"

cases.name: eu-common-cs-lookup The EU EDQM code system of 2026-10-13 is served
cases.gherkin:
# The EDQM code system carries its own edition (^version in edqm.fsh), not
# the package version; the value set below checks the package version.
Scenario: eu-common-cs-lookup The EU EDQM code system of 2026-10-13 is served
  When Client looks up a code on TxServer with:
    """
    { "resourceType": "Parameters", "parameter": [
        { "name": "system", "valueUri": "http://hl7europe.org/fhir/terminology/common/CodeSystem/edqm" },
        { "name": "version", "valueString": "2026-10-13" },
        { "name": "code", "valueCode": "SOM" } ] }
    """
  Then $response.status should be 200
  And $response should satisfy "parameter.where(name = 'display').value = 'state of matter'"

steps.description: Step 3: FHIRPath assertion: parameter.where(name = 'display').value = 'state of matter'
